title: 第5章 修炼从炼体开始第6章 不要的天才就杀了
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
云星落给韩自在喂上一小碗血，她也很想知道，自己的血到底有没有奇效。
让她吃惊的是，她的血治愈能力比她想象的还要强。
鲜血才入体不久，老者原本还咕噜咕噜冒血的地方瞬间止住，惨白的脸也开始有了颜色。
“这么快，顶级疗伤丹都没那么快吧？”
云星落自己也惊呆了。
“顶级疗伤丹算什么，你那是圣血，堪比圣药，以后你开始修炼了一定要保护好自己，绝不能让自己血的香味让人闻到。”
韩自在提醒道。
“多谢前辈，我知道。”
云星落看韩自在没有了性命危险，便接着收拾骨骸。
她整整收捡了三天，才把那些骨骸收拾干净，并把它们合葬在了一起，立了一块碑。
碑文刻着：摘星宗全体弟子之墓。
随着所有骨骸入土为安，整个空间的怨气一扫而空，天空变得清明起来。
远处灰蒙蒙的山峦也全部变得清晰，整个宗门的景象尽收眼底。
宗门面积很大，足有上十万亩地，光是演武场就好几个，弟子洞府遍布几座山头。
然而一场大战，所有建筑全部坍塌，随着岁月的流逝，几乎化成了尘土。
那些宗门的书籍早已化成了飞灰，所有武器除了那把镜子和诛邪剑，其他全部变成了废铁，一无所有。
云星落看着光秃秃的山峦和废墟，不由得一声叹息，“好不容易有个地方落脚，却是一无所有，这可怎么办？”
她现在就凡人一个，以后还要生活，还要修炼，想想就头疼。
“去云隐镇，那里可以买到物资和修炼资源。”
韩自在喝了云星落的血，已经能坐起来了。

他拿出一袋灵石，交给了云星落，“你救了我的命，这些灵石就当是报答你了。”
云星落接过灵石袋，打开一看不由得惊呼出声，一百万块，还是上品灵石。
要知道，她以前在天剑宗也是亲传弟子，但一个月也只有一百多块灵石，还只是中品灵石。
现在她一下子就有一百块万块上品灵石，她怎么能不开心。
“发了，我真的发了！”
云星落几乎要笑出声。
下一刻，韩自在打断了她的美梦，“你也不要太开心，这些钱除了给你买物质，我还需要你帮我买一些药草，我要治伤。”
“哦。”
云星落敛了笑容，“老头，你还把我当跑腿的啊，你知不知道，我现在没有修为，就一个凡人。”
“如黑雾森林这种龙潭虎穴，一个凡人出门随时就挂了，你还让我跑腿？”
韩自在摇摇头，抚摸着有些邋遢的胡子，“一看你就是没怎么出门的，你不知道吧，在黑雾森林里，只要不入森林，在小镇之中，凡人才是最安全的。”
“怎么讲？”
“黑雾森林里有规定，在镇子上，可以打斗，但不能打杀凡人。
凡是杀凡人的修士，会被所有修士一起围攻。”
“还有这规定？”
云星落还是第一次听说。
“当然，因为黑雾森林里每天都打斗不断，镇子里每天到处都是伤员。
这时候，就需要一些不受伤的凡人来干活了。”
content_en:
Yun Xingluo fed Han Zizai a small bowl of blood. She also wanted to know whether her blood had any miraculous effects.
To her surprise, her blood's healing powers were stronger than she imagined.
Not long after the blood entered his body, the place where the old man was bleeding stopped instantly, and his pale face began to gain color.
"So fast, even the top healing pills are not that fast, right?"
Yun Xingluo himself was shocked.
"What is the top healing pill? Yours is holy blood, comparable to holy medicine. When you start practicing in the future, you must protect yourself and never let others smell the fragrance of your blood."
Han Zizai reminded.
"Thank you, senior, I know."
Seeing that Han Zizai's life was not in danger, Yun Xingluo continued to collect the bones.
It took her three full days to clean up the bones, bury them together, and erect a monument.
The inscription reads: The tomb of all the disciples of the Star Reaching Sect.
As all the bones were laid to rest, the resentment in the entire space was swept away, and the sky became clear.
The gray mountains in the distance all became clear, and the entire sect was in full view.
The sect covers a large area, with over 100,000 acres of land. There are several martial arts arenas and disciple caves spread across several hills.
However, after a great war, all the buildings collapsed and almost turned into dust as the years passed.
The sect's books had long been turned into ashes, and all the weapons, except for the mirror and the evil-killing sword, had all turned into scrap metal, with nothing left.
Yun Xingluo looked at the bare mountains and ruins and couldn't help but sigh, "Finally, I found a place to stay, but I have nothing. What should I do?"
She is just a mortal now, and she will have to live and practice in the future. Just thinking about it gives her a headache.
"Go to Yunyin Town, where you can buy supplies and training resources."
Han Zizai drank Yun Xingluo's blood and was able to sit up.
He took out a bag of spirit stones and handed them to Yun Xingluo, "You saved my life, these spirit stones are my reward for you."
Yun Xingluo took the bag of spiritual stones, opened it and couldn't help but exclaimed, one million yuan, still a top-grade spiritual stone.
You know, she used to be a direct disciple of the Tianjian Sect, but she only had more than a hundred spiritual stones a month, and they were only middle-grade spiritual stones.
Now she suddenly has one million yuan of high-grade spiritual stones, how could she not be happy.
"Sent it, I really did it!"
Yun Xingluo almost laughed out loud.
The next moment, Han Zizai interrupted her sweet dream, "Don't be too happy. In addition to buying you material things with this money, I also need you to buy some herbs for me to treat my injuries."
"Oh."
Yun Xingluo suppressed his smile, "Old man, you still treat me as an errand boy. Do you know that I have no cultivation now, I am just a mortal."
"Like the Black Mist Forest, where a mortal can die anytime he goes out, you still want me to run errands?"
Han Zizai shook his head and stroked his slovenly beard. "You don't go out much. Don't you know that in the black mist forest, mortals are the safest in small towns as long as they don't enter the forest."
"How to say it?"
“There are rules in the Black Mist Forest. In the town, you can fight, but you cannot kill mortals.
Any monk who kills a mortal will be besieged by all the monks. "
"Is there still such a rule?"
This was the first time Yun Xingluo heard about it.
“Of course, because there are constant fighting every day in the Black Mist Forest, and there are wounded everywhere in the town every day.
At this time, some uninjured mortals are needed to do the work. "
